correctness.rationale: For w≥0, four positive norm facets f1=x+z/2,f2=y+z/2,f3=(2x+2y+z)/3,f4=5(x+y)/6 satisfy exact coefficientwise 3f3-2f_i=(0,2,0),(2,0,0),(2/3,2/3,1/3),(1/3,1/3,1), respectively; independently verified with rational arithmetic. Hence f3(w)≥(2/3)N(w), and for any positive unit u,v, N(u-v)≤N(u+v)≥f3(u)+f3(v)≥4/3. Published pair (4/5,0,2/5),(0,4/5,2/5) attains 4/3. Equality forces each vector onto either x=0 or y=0 facet; same-type pairs yield norm 2. Opposite types u=(a,0,2(1-a)),v=(0,b,2(1-b)) have sum facets 2-b,2-a,4/3,5(a+b)/6. Their simultaneous ≤4/3 inequalities give a,b≥2/3,a+b≤8/5; the complete triangle has vertices (2/3,2/3),(14/15,2/3),(2/3,14/15). Previously established beta=15/11 implies gap 1/33 and ratio 45/44 without claiming new beta proof.
